> **Windows HarfBuzz compatibility** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.4) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.4)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.4 includes a Windows HarfBuzz build that passes the BinSkim BA2007 check.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Windows HarfBuzz BinSkim compatibility** — The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged. ([#5122](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5122))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.104

The bundled Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged; unrelated pre-existing BinSkim warnings remain.
